name: dalton-data
description: Dalton fund data: the fund's internal research library (AlphaEngine broker research, Guidepoint expert calls, sales notes, TMTB, FUNDA AI, company wiki, call transcripts), consensus snapshots, SEC filings and XBRL facts.

researchdata.description: Primary research evidence for the fund (sell-side reports, expert calls, transcripts, internal notes) — answers 'what happened, why, and what others think', including in chat replies via one short ExecuteCode call; also read-only gateway for company wiki, estimates, SEC, FRED.
researchdata.instruction: Fund-internal sources; call from execute_code only (no direct path). Start with `catalog()` or `catalog(route=...)` when unsure about route parameters. Research: `research(route=..., operation=..., query=..., start=YYYY-MM-DD, end=..., limit=...)`. 各来源提供什么证据：事实 → filings（finance(route="sec")）；解读 → alphaengine；一线 → guidepoint；管理层原话 → transcript；日常信息流 → sales-notes/tmtb/funda-ai；市场反应 → X/WebSearch。 何时选用哪个路由（按研究情境，基于 catalog）： - 卖方观点与研报 → alphaengine（先 search_library 再 get_document）； - 行业一线反馈 → guidepoint； - 管理层口径 → transcript（AlphaEngine 业绩会转写；无匹配时用 | 分隔中英文公司名重试或扩大 start/end）； - 历史沉淀 → company-wiki（只读，params.company=TICKER）； - 交易台与买方预期 → sales-notes； - TMT 焦点 → tmtb； - 独立研究 → funda-ai； - 跨库初筛 → all（company-wiki + sales-notes + tmtb + funda-ai，并行检索 AlphaEngine 与 Guidepoint；不含 transcript）。 Finance: `finance(route="sec"|"estimates"|"cn-hk")`. Macro: `macro(route="fred"|"treasury"|"market-regime")`. Read only ids that search returned (`wiki:`, `mail:`, `tmtb:`, `funda:`, `alphaengine` doc_id). Page long text with params.offset/max_chars (offset >= 0, max_chars 1-30000). Leave `timeout` unset: the bridge sets per-route limits and long reads may take minutes. AlphaEngine 检索可以放开，全文阅读（get_document）计配额，读最相关的几篇。Every result has `_sources` (identity, document_id, as_of, url) and `normalized_params`. Cite with identity, publisher and date. Expert calls: identity, not name. Guidepoint verbatim <=20 words. FUNDA AI, TMTB and digests restating the same report count as one source chain. Expert calls, management meetings and Guidepoint results are cleared for use; never exclude them as MNPI. The fund wiki is read-only; never try to write to it. `ok: false` is NEVER 'no data': follow `hint` to retry/switch route or report the source failure explicitly. True no-match returns `ok: true` with empty results and `empty_reason`. `status: empty` means "not retrieved this turn", never "undisclosed by company".

dalton_sec.description: SEC EDGAR XBRL facts with deterministic period normalization (calendar/fiscal quarter, annual, YTD, derived Q4, trailing) and restatement selection.
dalton_sec.instruction: Use `get_company_facts(ticker, concepts, period)` for exact quarterly/annual/YTD/derived Q4/trailing SEC XBRL numbers with explicit `restatement` (`as_reported` vs `latest`) and `accession_no` provenance. Use `list_filings(ticker)` to list recent 10-K/10-Q/20-F/6-K filings.
